Package io.webagent4j.examples

package io.webagent4j.examples
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ActionFailureExample
    Demonstrates inspecting a normal structured action failure.
    BrowserCrawlSessionExample
    Demonstrates session reuse and cancellation: every page this crawl navigates shares the same IBrowser's cookies/storage/authentication state, and a CancellationToken can stop an in-progress crawl from another thread without forcibly aborting an in-flight navigation.
    BrowserCrawlSimpleExample
    Demonstrates the simplest browser crawl: a bounded, same-host breadth-first crawl through a real (headless) browser, following JavaScript-rendered <a href> links that a static-HTML crawl (HttpCrawlSimpleExample) would miss.
    ClickActionExample
    Demonstrates a semantic click with a visible-text postcondition.
    CompactObservationExample
    Renders an observation as compact deterministic semantic text.
    DownloadActionExample
    Demonstrates a verified browser download with explicit collision handling.
    ExtractAttributeExample
    Demonstrates attribute extraction and typed list extraction: reads a link's href, then every product name on the page as a single, deterministically ordered list.
    ExtractFromFrameExample
    Demonstrates frame-scoped extraction with typed conversion: resolves an iframe named "checkout", reads its total as text, and converts it to a BigDecimal - reusing the exact same live frame re-resolution IFrame.locate(io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition) already has, so a frame replaced mid-wait is still followed correctly.
    ExtractTableExample
    Demonstrates structured table extraction: reads an accessible HTML table's headers and rows, then accesses one cell both by column index and by header name.
    ExtractTextExample
    Demonstrates the simplest extraction: resolve one element by its semantic role and accessible name, and read its normalized visible text - reusing the exact same locator resolution find()/locate() already use, not a second DOM search.
    FormActionExample
    Demonstrates deterministic form entry, secret handling, and submission.
    FormObservationExample
    Shows safe form structure without printing captured values.
    FrameActionPlanExample
    Demonstrates dryRun() and IActionPlan for a frame-scoped action: a dry run resolves the frame and the target and checks preconditions without ever clicking, and a plan built once is only actually executed - re-resolving both the frame boundary and the target fresh - when IActionPlan.execute() is called.
    FrameLookupExample
    Demonstrates the simplest public frame lookup: resolve one <iframe> by its stable name attribute, then interact with a target inside it exactly like any page-level find() chain.
    FrameNavigationExample
    Demonstrates backend-neutral frame navigation: IFrame.navigate(String) replaces only that frame's own document - the top-level page and any sibling frames are untouched - and normal find() queries issued afterward search the new document.
    GovernedExecutionExample
    Demonstrates governed execution on a single NAVIGATE action: an IActionPolicy restricting which action types/idempotency this navigation may have, and an INetworkPolicy restricting the destination's scheme/host and denying private/loopback addresses - then prints the resulting ActionDecisionTrace.
    HttpCrawlDiagnosticsExample
    Demonstrates full crawl diagnostics: every CrawlStatistics field, plus each structured CrawlFailure - the crawler's fail-closed contract means an unexpected backend problem always surfaces here, never as a silently missing page.
    HttpCrawlRestrictedExample
    Demonstrates scope restriction: sameHostOnly, a path exclusion pattern, and a maxPages bound - then prints every rejected link alongside the CrawlDecisionType that explains why it was never fetched.
    HttpCrawlSimpleExample
    Demonstrates the simplest HTTP crawl: a bounded, same-host breadth-first crawl with no browser, no JavaScript rendering, and no AI - just HttpCrawler following <a href> links.
    NestedFrameExample
    Demonstrates nested frame traversal: an IFrame exposes its own frame() entry point, so a frame declared inside another frame's document is resolved strictly inside that parent's scope - it can never accidentally match a same-named frame belonging to the top-level page or a sibling frame.
    ObservationDiffExample
    Captures fresh snapshots around a page mutation and computes their semantic diff.
    ObservationExample
    Prints the buttons from a bounded immutable semantic observation.
    VerifiedActionExample
    Demonstrates polling multiple postconditions and capturing semantic state.
    VerifiedNavigationExample
    Executable example covering the first complete semantic browser vertical.
    WorkflowLoginExample
    Demonstrates a deterministic, sequential webagent4j-workflow definition: typed public and secret variables, required inputs, a conditionally skipped step, real action-pipeline integration, and a structured, secret-masked result.
    WorkflowRecordingExample
    Demonstrates webagent4j-recording: capture one workflow execution into a versioned, secret-safe WorkflowRecording, round-trip it through canonical JSON, then verify a second independent execution against the decoded recording with WorkflowReplayVerifier.
